Darr ke bhi kaam karna bahaduri hai.
Chup rehne mein hi hum apne aap ko paate hain.
Jo apne aap ko jeet leta hai, wahi sabse powerful warrior hai.
Himmat azaadi ki seedhi hai.
Grit lambi hai.
Doubt ke bawajood kaam karna—himmat.
Apni life ko masterpiece bana.
Umeed ek kriya hai.
Darr ke aage badhna hi himmat hai.
Grit pressure mein persistence hai.
Bahadur be-dar nahi; woh amal karte.
Khamoshi emptiness nahi.
Kamyabi aakhri nahi, haar jaanlewa nahi.
Endurance stubborn nahi; purpose ke saath rukna hai.
Khamoshi sunne ka art hai.
Lambe raaste se mat daro.
Shaant dimag mein gehra grit hota hai.
Silence pressure ko clarity banata.
Sabse strong jawab kabhi kabhi khamoshi.
Quiet logon ke paas sabse loud minds hote hain.
Himmat endure karne ki ability hai.
